hooks.text: 以第一人称法师视角把动作肉鸽与FPS融合
hooks.excerpt: Action Roguelite meets FPS Revenge of the Mage pulls the camera down right into the cowl of a mage so you can experience the magic and destruction in person!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 不同先祖赋予独立元素能力，并持续解锁新流派
hooks.excerpt: You have a variety of Ancestors to choose from, each with different elemental powers. You will unlock even more as you play the game, providing new styles so you can find your favorite.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三十多张升级卡在升级时出现，并可多次强化
hooks.excerpt: With 30+ unique cards - we are adding more- to be offered when you level up, each of which can be upgraded several times for greater effect, every playthrough will be different.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: After eight months It's a leaderboard and some UI tweaks. That's it.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 有一张地图明显未完成

excerpts.excerpt: one map is completely unfinished and very much noticable
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 部分Boss可被拾取物轻易压制

excerpts.excerpt: You can cheese bosses like no tomorrow with the pickups.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 低画质下仍会降到约20帧

excerpts.excerpt: I'm getting as low as 20 fps on low settings on forest.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 升级选项当前十分有限
魔法射击玩法循环容易上瘾
吸收精华并释放法术很有满足感

excerpts.excerpt: absorbing enemy essences and casting powerful spells feels deeply satisfying
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 升级过程容易让人上瘾

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
